_description: Settings of the AgriPoliS social-ecological extension (models/agripolis/src/SesExtension.*). Values are assumptions to be varied in sensitivity runs unless marked otherwise.

awareness._aw_value_note: Non-market value of stewardship per ha at awareness 1; calibrated so that the baseline keeps the surveyed share of protected/low-input land (see results/calibration).
awareness._feedback_note: Response to the experienced decline of the ALMaSS biodiversity indicator; 0 in uncoupled runs, set by the coupled scenarios.

_no_exit_note: Households keep their land-use rights (Land Law 2024); AgriPoliS' exit on opportunity cost is switched off.

change_limits._note: max_expand: share of the farm's land of that type newly converted per year (scaled by 0.25 + 0.75 x asset index); max_contract: share of the current area that can be given up per year; secure_tenure: expansion only with a land-use certificate.
